scope: Only the 20 listed theorem/lemma declarations, including commutator-power formulas and the frozen vector conclusion for p,q in {0,1}.

machine.build_mode: Independent direct sequential lean -o compilation of four frozen copies; author offline Lake log separately inspected; ordinary online lake build not run.

statement_fidelity.notes: Definitional unfolding gives xy-yx; the sign agrees with XY-YX=Z.
Distribute x(y+z) and (y+z)x, then regroup in the additive abelian group.
Both x0 and 0x vanish.
Distribute negation; x(-y)-(-y)x=-(xy-yx).
The two unit products are equal.
Expand [x,y]z+y[x,z]; the middle yxz terms cancel without exchanging factors.
Expand wx^(r+1)+(xw-wx)x^r, using x^(r+1)=x*x^r; associativity cancels wx*x^r.
yx-xy=-(xy-yx), by additive group identities.
Induct on n. Leibniz gives [x,y^(n+2)]=[x,y^(n+1)]y+y^(n+1)[x,y]. Move [x,y] past y using only the stated Y-Z commute hypothesis and combine the two natural-number multiples.
Rearrange the previous commutator formula to xy^(n+1)=y^(n+1)x+(n+1)y^n[x,y]; the correction has positive sign.
Split n=0 from n=m+1. At zero the natural scalar is zero and [x,1]=0; truncated n-1 causes no boundary defect.
Swap x and y, use [y,x]=-[x,y], and transport X-Z commutation across negation. Rearrangement yields the positive correction (n+1)x^n[x,y].

Independently expand the literal full certificate in the free associative integer algebra: both sides have coefficient 2 on all 32 words of length five, residual zero. The correction terms are left/right multiples of RX=x[x,y]-[x,y]x and RY=y[x,y]-[x,y]y, so vanish by the local commuting hypotheses. The remaining summands end on the RIGHT in x^2 and y^2.

Independently expand the literal full certificate: both sides have coefficient 2 on all eight words of length three, residual zero. Corrections are -RX-2RY. The surviving right factors are x^2 and y, giving the asymmetric (1,0) case.
Rewrite v+v as (2:K) scalar-multiplying v; multiply by inverse 2. Field and characteristic zero imply 2 is nonzero. K is explicitly retained by include K, avoiding loss of the scalar field binder.

Evaluate the degree-five ring identity in End_K(V) at v. Endomorphism multiplication is composition with right factor acting first; Ax^2(v) and By^2(v) vanish from the vector hypotheses. Apply vector_two_cancel to the remaining twice-output vector. No operator annihilation or finite dimension is used.
Evaluate the degree-three certificate at v; its right factors X^2 and Y vanish at v. Cancel the factor 2 in the characteristic-zero vector space.
Apply the preceding case after swapping X,Y. The commutator changes sign, and both commuting hypotheses are transported by neg_right. Y+X=X+Y for endomorphism addition; exponents remain three.
At exponent one, (X+Y)v=Xv+Yv=0. The actual signature needs neither characteristic zero nor commutator assumptions; this stronger auxiliary statement applies to the target boundary case.

For natural numbers p,q with each at most one, exhaust p=0/1 and q=0/1. Exponent 2p+2q+1 becomes respectively 1,3,3,5, and annihilator powers become 1 or 2. These are exactly the four proved vector cases.

definitions.notes: Explicit Field and CharZero; arbitrary dimension; all natural p,q; vector annihilation; local X-Z and Y-Z commutation. Definitional equality to independently restated contract checked by rfl.
Elaborated signature drops unused Algebra Q R; it has only Ring R, AddCommGroup V, Module R V and requires centrality in every ambient ring element. Not used to assert the frozen target.

remaining_obligations: Prove VectorConjecture for arbitrary natural p,q. It is only a def; no theorem asserts it.
The arbitrary p=0 or q=0 families are not proved here; only p,q simultaneously at most one are covered.

A general one-sided proof must formalize its own valid dependencies (for example PBW/grading, left-ideal membership and the line/fewnomial argument), or provide another complete route. Commented Taylor, iterated commutator, z-power, trinomial and two-sided proof plans are not accepted theorems.
General sharpness is a separate target and has not been formally proved by these modules.
